```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(DescTools)

## SpaceX_res_all_3celltype_update file
setwd("/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/SpaceX_BSNMani/data")

## read 4 data
baseline = readRDS("Baseline_co_expression_list_uni.RDS")
hdwgcna = readRDS("hdWGCNA_co_expression_list_uni.RDS")
spacex = readRDS("SpaceX_co_expression_list_uni.RDS")
smoothie= readRDS("Smoothie_co_expression_list_uni.RDS")

 
baseline_filter = baseline
hdwgcna_filter = hdwgcna
spacex_filter = spacex
smoothie_filter = smoothie


safe_fisherz <- function(mat) {
  FisherZ(mat)
}
baseline_z  <- lapply(baseline_filter, safe_fisherz)
hdwgcna_z   <- lapply(hdwgcna_filter, safe_fisherz)
spacex_z    <- lapply(spacex_filter, safe_fisherz)
smoothie_z  <- lapply(smoothie_filter, safe_fisherz)

set_diag_zero <- function(lst) {
  lapply(lst, function(mat) {
    diag(mat) <- 0
    return(mat)
  })
}

baseline_z  <- set_diag_zero(baseline_z)
hdwgcna_z   <- set_diag_zero(hdwgcna_z)
spacex_z    <- set_diag_zero(spacex_z)
smoothie_z  <- set_diag_zero(smoothie_z)

keep_vars <- c("baseline_z", "hdwgcna_z", "spacex_z", "smoothie_z")
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), keep_vars))
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

setwd("/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/4heatmap_comparison/Visualization")

for (i in 1:27) {
  print(i)
  patient_name <- names(baseline_z)[i]
  print(paste0("we are dealing with: ", patient_name))
  
  baseline_temp <- as.matrix(baseline_z[[i]])
  hdwgcna_temp <- as.matrix(hdwgcna_z[[i]])
  spacex_temp <- as.matrix(spacex_z[[i]])
  smoothie_temp <- as.matrix(smoothie_z[[i]])
  
  all_vals <- c(baseline_temp, hdwgcna_temp, spacex_temp, smoothie_temp)
  all_vals <- all_vals[is.finite(all_vals)]
  val_range <- max(abs(quantile(all_vals, probs = c(0.01, 0.99))))
  val_range <- ceiling(val_range * 10) / 10  
  
  breaks <- seq(-val_range, val_range, length.out = 100)
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(99)
  
  p1_baseline <- pheatmap(baseline_temp,
                          color = colors,
                          breaks = breaks,
                          main = "WGCNA",
                          cluster_rows = TRUE,
                          cluster_cols = TRUE,
                          fontsize_row = 1.5,
                          fontsize_col = 1.5,
                          treeheight_row = 0,
                          treeheight_col = 0,
                          border_color = NA,
                          silent = TRUE)
  
  row_order <- p1_baseline$tree_row$order
  col_order <- p1_baseline$tree_col$order
  
  p2_hdwgcna <- pheatmap(hdwgcna_temp[row_order, col_order],
                         color = colors,
                         breaks = breaks,
                         main = "hdWGCNA",
                         cluster_rows = FALSE,
                         cluster_cols = FALSE,
                         fontsize_row = 1.5,
                         fontsize_col = 1.5,
                         border_color = NA,
                         silent = TRUE)
  
  p3_spacex <- pheatmap(spacex_temp[row_order, col_order],
                        color = colors,
                        breaks = breaks,
                        main = "SpaceX",
                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                        cluster_cols = FALSE,
                        fontsize_row = 1.5,
                        fontsize_col = 1.5,
                        border_color = NA,
                        silent = TRUE)
  
  p4_smoothie <- pheatmap(smoothie_temp[row_order, col_order],
                          color = colors,
                          breaks = breaks,
                          main = "Smoothie",
                          cluster_rows = FALSE,
                          cluster_cols = FALSE,
                          fontsize_row = 1.5,
                          fontsize_col = 1.5,
                          border_color = NA,
                          silent = TRUE)
  
  png(paste0("compare_4_methods_", patient_name, ".png"), width = 5000, height = 3000, res = 600)
  grid.arrange(p1_baseline$gtable,
               p2_hdwgcna$gtable,
               p3_spacex$gtable,
               p4_smoothie$gtable,
               ncol = 2,
               top = textGrob(paste0("Patient ", patient_name,"'s comparison heatmap"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")))
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(pheatmap)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

data_dir <- "/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/SpaceX_BSNMani/data"
out_dir  <- "/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/hdWGCNA_vs_Smoothie_comparison"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

hdwgcna  <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "hdWGCNA_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))
smoothie <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "Smoothie_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))

common_donors <- intersect(names(hdwgcna), names(smoothie))

safe_fisherz <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mat[mat >= 1]  <- 0.999999
  mat[mat <= -1] <- -0.999999
  z <- atanh(mat)
  dimnames(z) <- dimnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- NA
  diag(z) <- 0
  z
}

align_pair <- function(mat1, mat2) {
  mat1 <- as.matrix(mat1)
  mat2 <- as.matrix(mat2)

  if (!is.null(rownames(mat1)) && !is.null(rownames(mat2))) {
    common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(
      rownames(mat1), colnames(mat1),
      rownames(mat2), colnames(mat2)
    ))

    mat1 <- mat1[common_genes, common_genes, drop = FALSE]
    mat2 <- mat2[common_genes, common_genes, drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    stopifnot(all(dim(mat1) == dim(mat2)))
  }

  list(hdwgcna = mat1, smoothie = mat2)
}

get_pair_z <- function(donor) {
  pair <- align_pair(hdwgcna[[donor]], smoothie[[donor]])
  list(
    hdwgcna = safe_fisherz(pair$hdwgcna),
    smoothie = safe_fisherz(pair$smoothie)
  )
}

upper_vals <- function(mat) {
  mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]
}

compare_one_donor <- function(donor) {
  pair <- get_pair_z(donor)

  x <- upper_vals(pair$hdwgcna)
  y <- upper_vals(pair$smoothie)
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]

  data.frame(
    donor = donor,
    n_edges = length(x),
    edge_pearson = cor(x, y, method = "pearson"),
    edge_spearman = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"),
    mean_abs_diff = mean(abs(x - y)),
    median_abs_diff = median(abs(x - y)),
    frobenius_diff = sqrt(sum((x - y)^2)),
    sign_discordance = mean(sign(x) != sign(y))
  )
}

comparison_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(common_donors, compare_one_donor))
write.csv(
  comparison_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "hdWGCNA_vs_Smoothie_edgewise_summary_v2.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Option 1: manually choose donors that visually show clear hdWGCNA-Smoothie differences
selected_donors <- c("H20.33.044", "H21.33.014", "H21.33.021", "H21.33.040")
selected_donors <- selected_donors[selected_donors %in% common_donors]

## Option 2: if manual donors are unavailable, automatically choose most different donors
# selected_donors <- c()
# if (length(selected_donors) == 0) {
#   comparison_summary <- comparison_summary[order(comparison_summary$edge_pearson), ]
#   selected_donors <- head(comparison_summary$donor, 4)
# }

## Shared color scale across selected donors
all_vals <- c()
for (donor in selected_donors) {
  pair <- get_pair_z(donor)
  all_vals <- c(all_vals, as.vector(pair$hdwgcna), as.vector(pair$smoothie))
}
all_vals <- all_vals[is.finite(all_vals)]

val_range <- max(abs(quantile(all_vals, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)))
val_range <- ceiling(val_range * 10) / 10

colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-val_range, val_range, length.out = 101)

heatmap_grobs <- list()

for (donor in selected_donors) {
  pair <- get_pair_z(donor)

  p_hdw <- pheatmap(
    pair$hdwgcna,
    color = colors,
    breaks = breaks,
    main = paste0(donor, " hdWGCNA"),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0,
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "grey90",
    silent = TRUE
  )

  row_order <- p_hdw$tree_row$order
  col_order <- p_hdw$tree_col$order

  p_sm <- pheatmap(
    pair$smoothie[row_order, col_order],
    color = colors,
    breaks = breaks,
    main = paste0(donor, " Smoothie"),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "grey90",
    silent = TRUE
  )

  heatmap_grobs <- c(heatmap_grobs, list(p_hdw$gtable, p_sm$gtable))
}

png(
  file.path(out_dir, "Supplementary_hdWGCNA_vs_Smoothie_multi_donor_heatmaps_v2.png"),
  width = 4800,
  height = 2200 * length(selected_donors),
  res = 600
)

grid.arrange(
  grobs = heatmap_grobs,
  ncol = 2,
  top = textGrob(
    "Additional donor-level representative comparisons of hdWGCNA and Smoothie",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(DescTools)
library(pheatmap)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

data_dir <- "/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/SpaceX_BSNMani/data"
out_dir  <- "/home/koe/BSNMani_application-main/Tong_results/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani_for_transfer/BSNMani/4method_heatmap_updated"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

baseline <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "Baseline_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))
hdwgcna  <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "hdWGCNA_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))
spacex   <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "SpaceX_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))
smoothie <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "Smoothie_co_expression_list_uni.RDS"))

# spacex_filter = spacex
# smoothie_filter = smoothie
#

# spacex_z    <- lapply(spacex_filter, safe_fisherz)
# smoothie_z  <- lapply(smoothie_filter, safe_fisherz)
# 
# set_diag_zero <- function(lst) {

#     diag(mat) <- 0
#     return(mat)
#   })
# }
# 
# baseline_z  <- set_diag_zero(baseline_z)
# hdwgcna_z   <- set_diag_zero(hdwgcna_z)
# spacex_z    <- set_diag_zero(spacex_z)
# smoothie_z  <- set_diag_zero(smoothie_z)
# 
# keep_vars <- c("baseline_z", "hdwgcna_z", "spacex_z", "smoothie_z")
# rm(list = setdiff(ls(), keep_vars))


safe_fisherz <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mat[mat >= 1]  <- 0.999999
  mat[mat <= -1] <- -0.999999
  z <- atanh(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- NA
  diag(z) <- 0
  dimnames(z) <- dimnames(mat)
  z
}

align_four_methods <- function(donor) {
  if (!(donor %in% names(baseline)) ||
      !(donor %in% names(hdwgcna)) ||
      !(donor %in% names(spacex)) ||
      !(donor %in% names(smoothie))) {
    stop(paste0("Donor not found in all four method lists: ", donor))
  }

  mats <- list(
    WGCNA = as.matrix(baseline[[donor]]),
    hdWGCNA = as.matrix(hdwgcna[[donor]]),
    SpaceX = as.matrix(spacex[[donor]]),
    Smoothie = as.matrix(smoothie[[donor]])
  )

  has_valid_names <- all(sapply(mats, function(x) {
    !is.null(rownames(x)) &&
      !is.null(colnames(x)) &&
      length(rownames(x)) > 0 &&
      length(colnames(x)) > 0
  }))

  if (has_valid_names) {
    common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, c(lapply(mats, rownames), lapply(mats, colnames)))

    if (length(common_genes) > 1) {
      mats <- lapply(mats, function(x) x[common_genes, common_genes, drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      message("No shared row/column names found. Using original matrix order.")
    }
  } else {
    message("Matrices do not have valid row/column names. Using original matrix order.")
  }

  dims <- lapply(mats, dim)
  if (length(unique(sapply(dims, paste, collapse = "x"))) != 1) {
    stop("Four method matrices do not have the same dimensions for donor: ", donor)
  }

  mats <- lapply(mats, safe_fisherz)
  mats
}

plot_four_method_heatmap <- function(donor, file_prefix = "Figure2a_updated") {
  mats <- align_four_methods(donor)

  all_vals <- unlist(lapply(mats, as.vector))
  all_vals <- all_vals[is.finite(all_vals)]

  if (length(all_vals) == 0) {
    stop("No finite values found after Fisher Z transformation for donor: ", donor)
  }

  val_range <- max(abs(quantile(all_vals, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)))

  if (!is.finite(val_range) || val_range == 0) {
    val_range <- max(abs(all_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  if (!is.finite(val_range) || val_range == 0) {
    val_range <- 1
  }

  val_range <- ceiling(val_range * 10) / 10

  colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
  breaks <- seq(-val_range, val_range, length.out = 101)

  p_hdw <- pheatmap(
    mats$hdWGCNA,
    color = colors,
    breaks = breaks,
    main = paste0(donor, " hdWGCNA"),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0,
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "grey90",
    silent = TRUE
  )

  row_order <- p_hdw$tree_row$order
  col_order <- p_hdw$tree_col$order

  plot_one <- function(mat, title) {
    pheatmap(
      mat[row_order, col_order],
      color = colors,
      breaks = breaks,
      main = title,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      show_rownames = FALSE,
      show_colnames = FALSE,
      border_color = NA,
      na_col = "grey90",
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  p_wgcna <- plot_one(mats$WGCNA, paste0(donor, " WGCNA"))
  p_space <- plot_one(mats$SpaceX, paste0(donor, " SpaceX"))
  p_smoo  <- plot_one(mats$Smoothie, paste0(donor, " Smoothie"))

  png(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "_", donor, "_4methods.png")),
    width = 5200,
    height = 1800,
    res = 600
  )

  grid.arrange(
    p_wgcna$gtable,
    p_hdw$gtable,
    p_space$gtable,
    p_smoo$gtable,
    ncol = 4,
    top = textGrob(
      paste0("Representative donor-level co-expression heatmaps: ", donor),
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )

  dev.off()
}
```


```{r}
## Recommended main Figure 2a candidate
plot_four_method_heatmap("H20.33.001", file_prefix = "main_candidate")

## Alternative strong candidate
plot_four_method_heatmap("H21.33.001", file_prefix = "main_candidate")

## Optional supplementary donors
supp_donors <- c("H20.33.044", "H21.33.031", "H21.33.040")

for (donor in supp_donors) {
  plot_four_method_heatmap(donor, file_prefix = "supplementary_candidate")
}
```
